label: Bible Study
prompt: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot _____, promised before the world began;
verse: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
note: Eternal life promised before the world began — by the one God who cannot lie.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well _____ to overcome it.
verse: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
note: Ten spies saw giants; Caleb saw a land they were well able to take.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an _____ to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verse: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
note: Noah built the ark after being warned of 'things not seen as yet' — faith in a forecast nobody else believed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But ye, brethren, be not _____ in well doing.
verse: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
note: Paul's tag after rebuking the idlers: don't let the freeloaders make you quit doing good.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the _____ from on high hath visited us,
verse: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
note: Zacharias' song over newborn John: the 'dayspring from on high' — the sunrise — has visited us.
